test_title: PYST 38: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: If a sum of ₹9,10,000 is invested for a year at 2% per annum compounded half yearly, then find the compound interest.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹9,10,000

Rate = 2% p.a. ⇒ half-yearly rate = 1%

Time = 1 year = 2 half-years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

CI = A − P

**Calculations:**

⇒ A = 910000(1 + 1/100)²

⇒ A = 910000(1.01)²

⇒ A = 910000 × 1.0201

⇒ A = 928291

⇒ CI = 928291 − 910000 = 18291

**∴ Compound Interest = ₹18,291**
